Q1.rationale: Segment 8 defines Confidential Information to cover information in oral, written or electronic form.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: The NDA sets confidentiality and non-disclosure duties but contains no restriction on use limited to the stated purposes.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: The NDA does not address any grant or denial of rights or licences in Confidential Information; segment 18 only disclaims a commitment to supply information.
Q3.label: NotMentioned

Q4.rationale: Segments 19 and 20 set confidentiality periods running beyond the agreement date (three years, sixty months, or completion of the Sale).
Q4.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Segment 24 requires the Disclosee to immediately notify the Sellers before any legally compelled disclosure.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: The NDA contains no reverse engineering prohibition.
Q9.label: NotMentioned

Q10.rationale: Segment 30 states that Confidential Information is limited to technical information and excludes business or financial information.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Segment 7c makes the fact of the Sale negotiations and any fact concerning the Sale Confidential Information, which covers disclosing the fact of negotiation.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q12.rationale: Segment 5 contemplates disclosure to professional advisors and segment 8 includes financial, legal and tax advisors among Representatives.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: The exclusions cover public information and prior possession, not acquisition of similar information from a third party.
Q13.label: NotMentioned

Q14.rationale: Segment 23 imposes a US$500,000 penalty on breach irrespective of actual loss suffered.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 8 covers all information of any kind, oral or written, with no requirement that it be expressly identified.
Q16.label: Contradiction

Q17.rationale: The NDA contains no permission to make copies of Confidential Information.
Q17.label: NotMentioned

Q18.rationale: The NDA contains no export control provision.
Q18.label: NotMentioned

Q19.rationale: Segment 24 allows only legally compelled disclosure to a regulatory authority, with notice, and the general confidentiality duty in segments 4 and 8 would otherwise bar voluntary reports to government agencies.
Q19.label: Entailment

Q20.rationale: Segment 8 names employees among the Representatives to whom Confidential Information may be provided, and segment 5 requires them to be made aware of the Agreement.
Q20.label: Entailment
